description: Canonical high-risk fabrication / uncontracted-commitment markers for the outbound provenance gate (ADR 0028 Tier-1, universal across verticals). This file is the SINGLE source of truth: the hermes-smd-overlay vendors a copy and a CI hash-check asserts the bytes match this artifact at its pinned SHA, so the two repos cannot drift. Derived from the CLAUDE.md 'No fabricated client-facing content' Pattern A/B rule and the Tone & Positioning style markers. Match `literal_ci` and `regex` case-insensitively; `literal` exactly. Every marker carries a `remedy`: the narrowest instruction that clears the refusal, appended to the refusal text the model receives. Reason alone strands work -- the em-dash marker stranded a daily-needs-you-digest memo on 2026-08-19 and again on 2026-09-02, each on a single attempt with no retry, while the identifier gate's remedy-bearing refusal recovers ~88% of the time. Remedies state what to DO and never restate the rule: on 2026-08-24 a refusal that named its rule taught the model to strip 38 matter numbers from a digest.

markers.note: Conduct floor (ss-console#2552): the Operator speaks about what it will do, never about what it holds on you. It must not volunteer that a preference was recorded, where it lives, or that a profile exists. Triggered by a live confirm email reading 'That preference is recorded to your profile'. Storage itself is trust-contracted (ADR 0048); narrating it is the defect. Nouns are scoped to profile/preferences deliberately: 'your file' and 'your record' carry heavy legitimate legal usage ('We have added your medical records to your file') and matching them false-positives on attributed firm prose. Asked directly what is known about them, the Operator answers in full: this bans volunteering, not disclosure.
markers.remedy: Rewrite in terms of what you will do. Say nothing about what a person did, failed to do, or intended.
